starting-off-talking-to-anne-or-will.speaker: Anne
starting-off-talking-to-anne-or-will.text: Ah, look what we have here, Will! This looks like someone who needs a good job!

starting-off-talking-to-anne-or-will.speaker: Will
starting-off-talking-to-anne-or-will.text: Goodness, Anne, I think you're right! This one's clearly never worked an honest day in their life, and it's about time someone changed that!
If the quest cannot be started:

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.text: Alas! We are sadly not currently in a place where we can take on any more staff, but let us hope that changes soon!

steps.player: Okay...

starting-off-talking-to-anne-or-will.speaker: Anne

steps.player: I guess so...?

steps.speaker: Will

steps.player: [player name].

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.text: Pleased to meet you, [player name]. I'm Anne, and this is Will.

steps.speaker: Will
steps.text: Next question: Do you have any experience captaining a ship?

steps.player: Not really...

steps.speaker: Will
steps.text: Oh...

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.text: Will, it's important we not be too picky! It's a competitive market, after all.

steps.speaker: Will
steps.text: Okay, final question: Do you agree to waive all rights to pursue legal action against your new employer in the event of injury or horrific death?

steps.player: Is that likely to happen?

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.text: Not at all!

steps.player: I'm not sure if I...

steps.speaker: Will
steps.text: Excellent! Well then, [player name], I'm pleased to say that we have the results of your interview. You bring some impressive stuff to the table. We'd love to offer you the role!

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.text: Congratulations!

steps.player: Thanks... only, you didn't actually mention what the role was...

steps.speaker: Will
steps.text: Ah, how forgetful of us! Given that you've already accepted, how about we discuss the details on our ship.

steps.player: But I didn't accept anything...

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.text: Just let us know when you're ready, and we'll hop aboard!

steps.player: I guess I'm ready...

steps.player: I'd rather not...

steps.player: Sorry, but I'm not looking for a job right now. I'm just going to go...

steps.speaker: Will
steps.text: Oh, you'll be back, friend! You already know you can't turn down an opportunity like this!

starting-off-talking-to-anne-or-will-aft.speaker: Anne

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.player: It's not really that open... We haven't even left port yet.

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.speaker: Anne
at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.text: Well, good news, [player name], because that's where you come in! You're our new helm!

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.speaker: Will
at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.text: It means you're in charge of the ship's helm! In other words, you're responsible for steering the ship!

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.player: It's more of a boat really...

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.speaker: Anne
at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.text: Well, we all have to start somewhere!

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.player: Right... So if I'm manning the helm, what will you two be doing?

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.speaker: Will
at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.text: Well, it's simple, isn't it? We're in charge!

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.player: Have you ever actually done this before?

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.speaker: Will
at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.text: Just never on our own ship before! This is an exciting first day for... well, we haven't actually named our business yet, but I'm sure we'll come up with a good name soon.

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.player: And what does this business do?
Of course. Alright then, I don't remember doing it, but apparently I committed to this. Where is our first wreck?

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.speaker: Will
at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.text: We've got a good one to get us started! Last time we were on the Pandemonium, we purchased a map that should lead us to an old pirate wreck.

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.speaker: Anne
at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.text: Have you never been? It's a great place for a drink! We'll have to take you there!

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.speaker: Will
at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.text: But first, let's collect some salvage! According to the map, the wreck is just east of the Karamja Shipyard, so south of here.

at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.speaker: Anne
at-the-boat-talking-to-anne-or-will.text: Over to you, [player name]! Take the helm when ready.

at-the-boat-talking-to-will-or-anne-befo.speaker: Anne
at-the-boat-talking-to-will-or-anne-befo.text: This is your bit, [player name]! Take the helm when ready.

at-the-boat-talking-to-will-or-anne-befo.speaker: Will
at-the-boat-talking-to-will-or-anne-befo.text: Remember, you need to take us to the wreck. It should be east of the Karamja Shipyard, so south of here.

steps.player: Okay, I'll get to it.

options.text: Actually, I want to go back to Port Sarim.

steps.player: Actually, I want to go back to Port Sarim.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.text: This isn't the can-do attitude we need, [player name], but fine, we'll go back...
The player goes back to Port Sarim.

steps.player: Okay.

sailing-the-boat-if-the-player-fails-to-.text: The wind does down and your sails with it.

sailing-the-boat-if-the-ship-gains-wind.text: You feed a gust of wind.

sailing-the-boat-if-the-ship-gains-wind.speaker: Anne

reaching-the-salvaging-point.speaker: Will
reaching-the-salvaging-point.text: Right, now that we're here, I think it's time to do some salvaging!

reaching-the-salvaging-point.speaker: Anne
reaching-the-salvaging-point.text: When you're ready, [player name], just lower the salvaging hook and let's see what we can find!

reaching-the-salvaging-point.player: Hang on... why am I lowering the hook? I thought the helm was my responsibility?

reaching-the-salvaging-point.speaker: Will
reaching-the-salvaging-point.text: Yes! The helm... and the hook!

reaching-the-salvaging-point.player: Of course. I'll just do everything while you two reap the rewards. Sounds about right.

reaching-the-salvaging-point.speaker: Will
reaching-the-salvaging-point.text: Don't go getting grumpy on us now, [player name]. This isn't about the rewards. It's all about the experience!

reaching-the-salvaging-point.speaker: Anne
reaching-the-salvaging-point.text: That's right! Think of what you'll learn today!

reaching-the-salvaging-point-deploying-t.speaker: Will

reaching-the-salvaging-point-deploying-t.speaker: Anne

reaching-the-salvaging-point-deploying-t.speaker: Anne
reaching-the-salvaging-point-deploying-t.text: Sorry, [player name]. If it's any consolation, you did a great job! Unfortunately, we just have to let you go.

reaching-the-salvaging-point-swimming-to.text: The player walks over to the Pandemonium.

reaching-the-salvaging-point-swimming-to.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
reaching-the-salvaging-point-swimming-to.text: Yo ho ho and a Jolly Roger to you, me hearty! I can see from the fact that you're totally drenched from head to toe that you are a fellow scallywag sailor! The name's Steve Beanie! Pleased to meet you.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.text: Yo ho ho and a Jolly Roger to you, me hearty! I can see from the fact that you're totally drenched from head to toe that you are a fellow scallywag sailor! The name's Steve Beanie! Pleased to meet you.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.player: I think I must be having some sort of fever dream... or maybe I'm dead?

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.text: Ha! Far from it, matey! Though the fever dream I can't comment on. They're rather common around here... but I assure you that it's well-nigh certainly like enough most likely not the rum doing it!

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.player: Okay... You said words there, but I don't think they actually formed a sentence.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.text: Ah, me wee hearty! You seem to be having quite the crisis! Thankfully, you've rigged the starboard and docked yourself at the right port! Welcome to the Pandemonium!

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.text: Aye! To be sure! This here is the finest establishment in all the seas. Sit back! Have a drink! Let the good times, and the rum, flow!

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.player: If this is the Pandemonium, do you know of a pair of salvagers called Will and Anne?

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.text: Avast ye! You name a pair of pinching looting plundering seadogs!

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.player: I see. So you do know them. They claimed to have purchased a map here, but I'm guessing they weren't being totally honest about that...

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.text: Purchased?! Purchased?! You're pulling my leg, you scallywag! Those scurvy dogs came here and broke the one rule of the Pandemonium! That map was pilfered! Stolen!

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.player: Well, I had quite the fun run in with them myself. They had me help them salvage an old shipwreck before throwing me overboard.
Thank you. It was the map they stole that led them to the wreck. What do you know about it?

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squawking-.text: Not a lot, I'm afraid. You should hoist your sails and go speak to Ribs instead. It was his map they looted. He's the old dog over in the corner. Avast!

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-squaking-s.text: If the player has not yet asked about Will and Anne:

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: The scallywag sailor returns! Have you come for a drink? We only have the best here on the Pandemonium!

steps.player: If this is the Pandemonium, do you know of a pair of salvagers called Will and Anne?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Avast ye! You name a pair of pinching looting plundering seadogs!

steps.player: Let's see what you have.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Aye!

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Those plundering seadogs! Did you speak to Ribs about them? It was his map they looted. He's the old dog over in the corner.

steps.player: Thanks. I'll go and speak to him now.

options.text: I think I might have lost a cup here.

steps.player: Nothing, thanks.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-chartin-ch.speaker: Chartin' Charles McAtless
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-chartin-ch.text: Hello there. I'm afraid I only talk to proper sailors, and I can see you're not quite at that level yet. However, you are welcome to admire me from afar.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.text: Okay... You should probably get going then.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-crew-r.speaker: Crew Registrar
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-crew-r.text: I'm the crew registrar. Here to cut through the red tape of crew management for anyone who needs it!

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-crew-r.player: A lot of paperwork in managing a crew is there?

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-crew-r.speaker: Crew Registrar
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-crew-r.text: You'd be surprised. Quality assurance guideline QA-275 states all crew must be appropriately fit and healthy after being subjected to QA form QA-275.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-crew-r.speaker: Crew Registrar
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-crew-r.text: QA-123 requires all crew to pass a mandatory cargo data protection course if the vessel can be fitted with a cargo hold.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-crew-r.speaker: Crew Registrar
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-crew-r.text: Then of course we have QA-441, which defines the background checks that any crewmate operating a sail must pass. And all that's without even considering QA- 215...

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-crew-r.player: That all sounds a bit much!

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-crew-r.speaker: Crew Registrar
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-crew-r.text: Well, it's not for everyone. Still, if you ever find yourself in need of a crew, you know where to find me.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.speaker: Ribs
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.text: Ahoy, young whippersnapper. Have you come to hear a tale from old Ribs?

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.player: Kind of, I guess. I was hoping you could tell me about Will and Anne, along with the map they stole.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.speaker: Ribs
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.text: A dark day. A very dark day. Those young fools know not what they have wrought upon themselves.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.speaker: Ribs
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.text: A curse! A curse most foul! That map marked the resting place of the Crimson Kraken! She was a deadly vessel, captained by none other than Barnacle Barnaby himself!

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.speaker: Ribs
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.text: You have not heard the tale of Barnacle Barnaby? You have not heard of the scourge of the Unquiet Ocean?

steps.player: No, tell me about him.

steps.speaker: Ribs
steps.text: He was a cruel and vicious pirate. Orchestrator of the Driftwood Massacre and unleasher of the Plague of Black Mists. He believed himself untouchable, but his arrogance was his undoing.

steps.speaker: Ribs
steps.text: Despite the warnings of many, Barnacle Barnaby attempted to plunder the Skullhorde, but his only reward was a deadly curse. It destroyed the Crimson Kraken, condemning all on board to a watery grave.

steps.player: And you had a map leading to the wreck of the Kraken?

steps.speaker: Ribs
steps.text: Aye! I purchased the map from Ulrich the Unfortunate, the sole survivor of the Kraken, but I had no intention of using it. I knew that no good would ever come from seeking the Kraken.

steps.player: Then why not destroy the map?

steps.speaker: Ribs
steps.text: And risk the wrath of Barnaby's ghost? No. Better the map be locked away, so that neither it nor the curse could harm anyone else.

steps.player: I'm not sure I quite follow your reasoning for keeping it, but I guess it doesn't matter now. I'm afraid Will and Anne found and looted the Kraken.

options.text: Now's not really the time for tales.

steps.player: Now's not really the time for tales.

steps.speaker: Ribs
steps.text: You are a fool for thinking that way, but on your head be it. The short of it is that Barnaby and the Kraken were cursed, condemning him and his crew to a watery grave.

steps.player: I see. Well, I'm afraid Will and Anne found and looted the Kraken.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.speaker: Ribs
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.text: I feared as much, though part of me still hoped it would not come to be. Tell me, did they find Barnaby's medallion?

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.player: They did. It was actually the only thing they were interested in.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.speaker: Ribs
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.text: Then the foul curse is now free once more. They must be stopped!

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.player: Well, I do have my own personal reasons for wanting Will and Anne dealt with. Maybe I could try and find them.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.speaker: Ribs
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.text: You are a brave soul indeed, but that is just what is needed at a time like this.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.speaker: Ribs
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs.text: You should talk to Steve. He already put out a bounty for Will and Anne after the theft. He might have heard something about where they could have gone.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs-again.speaker: Ribs
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs-again.text: Ahoy, young whippersnapper. Did you speak to Steve about that bounty?

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-ribs-again.player: Not yet. I'll go and see him now.

steps.player: About Will and Anne...

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Those plundering seadogs! Did you speak to Ribs about them?

steps.player: I did. He seems to think they might have unleashed some sort of curse.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Ah, the curse of Barnacle Barnaby! It's one of Ribs' favourite tales. Just a myth of course, but the old dog does love his stories.

steps.player: Well, myths aside, Ribs mentioned you'd put a bounty out for Will and Anne. I'd be quite keen to track them down myself.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Yo ho ho! A mighty good decision! It's a generous bounty indeed. You don't go breaking the one rule of the Pandemonium and expect to get away with it!

options.text: What exactly is this one rule you keep mentioning?

steps.player: What exactly is this one rule you keep mentioning?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Avast! The mainland kingdoms have no authority here. Their laws do not apply. Instead, we just have our one rule that keeps the Pandemonium afloat: Never disrespect your fellow patron.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: We don't care who you are. Indeed, pirates and customs officers can enjoy a drink here, side by side. Savvy?

steps.player: So anyone is welcome here as long as they don't commit an offense against any of the other patrons?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Yarr! You've got it!

steps.player: I see. So, back to Will and Anne. Do you have any idea where they might have gone?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Shiver me timbers! I'm afraid not. Old Grog said he might try and track them down. Perhaps he has an idea of where to find them.

options.text: Do you have any idea where Will and Anne might have gone?

steps.player: Do you have any idea where Will and Anne might have gone?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Shiver me timbers! I'm afraid not. Old Grog said he might try and track them down. Perhaps he has an idea of where to find them.

steps.player: And where would I find Old Grog?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Ah, the old scallywag left not that long ago, but he'll be back here before long. He enjoys a drink far too much! In the meantime, you should hoist the sails and ready your vessel!

steps.player: But I don't have a vessel...

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: What? But then how did you get here?

steps.player: Will and Anne threw me overboard and I washed up here. I did mention this earlier...

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Blistering barnacles! Well, you won't be getting far without a boat of your own. You should head to the docks and speak with Junior Jim, our local shipwright. He'll get you sorted out.

steps.player: Alright, I'll go and see him.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Jolly Roger!

options.text: I think I might have lost a cup here.
options.condition: If the player lost the old cup:

steps.player: About Will and Anne...

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Aye! Old Grog hasn't returned yet, but I'm sure he'll be back soon. In the meantime, you should head to the docks and speak with Junior Jim, our local shipwright. He'll get you sorted out with a boat of your own.

steps.player: Alright, I'll go and see him.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Jolly Roger!

options.text: I think I might have lost a cup here.
options.condition: If the player lost the old cup:

options.text: Could you tell me about the Pandemonium's one rule?

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: Can I help you, mate?

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: That's me. What do you need then?

talking-to-junior-jim.player: Steve said you might be able to sort me out with a boat.

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: You don't have a boat?

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: Ha! We've got ourselves a Billy-no-boats! Classic! Yeah, I can sort you out with a boat, but it's gonna cost you.

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: Well, what do you have?

talking-to-junior-jim.player: Er... I do have this cup I found. Perhaps I could trade it for a boat.

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: Alright, let's have a gander at it.
If the player lost the old cup:
You show the cup to Junior Jim.

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: Hmm... Yeah, yeah, I can work with this. This old rusty cup will get you the finest raft I have!

talking-to-junior-jim.player: Sorry, I think I must have misheard you. Did you say raft?

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: That's right! The best one I have!

talking-to-junior-jim.player: I was kind of hoping for a bit more than a raft. It's not just the cup I have. I'm sure I can make up the funds to buy something bigger.

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: Sorry, mate, but even if you could, the raft is all I've got to hand right now. Besides, you're gonna want to build up some experience before you captain anything too big. A raft will be perfect for you.

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: Lighten up, mate. I'll have plenty more vessels in stock soon. Come back once you've got a bit more know-how and I'll be able to sort you right out.

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: Now, about your raft... With that cup I'll be able to sort you out with the finest helm, but it won't be enough to cover the sails.

talking-to-junior-jim.player: But I won't get anywhere without sails!

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: Don't panic, you silly plonker. I ain't about to send you off on a raft with no sails. I'll sort them out for you, but I'll just need a little favour in return.

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: I've got some cargo I need picking up from Port Sarim and bringing back here. In return for sorting you out with some sails, I'll need you to go and collect it for me.

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: Oh, and I tell you what, I'll even set you up with the materials to whack together a cargo hold. You won't be shifting that cargo far without one.

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: Now, hand over that cup and we can get cracking.
You give the cup to Junior Jim.

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: Right, time to sort you out with a cargo hold. Let's head on over to the shipyard...
Junior Jim and the player head to the shipyard.

talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim.text: You'll want to grab yourself some tools from the crates over there, mate. After that, just use the gangplank to hop onto your raft. Once you're on board, you can get to work.

talking-to-junior-jim-talking-to-junior-.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim-talking-to-junior-.text: You're back! Do you have that cup? If so, let's have a gander at it.
If the player lost the cup:
If the player has the cup:

steps.speaker: Junior Jim
steps.text: Hmm... Yeah, yeah, I can work with this. This old rusty cup will get you the finest raft I have!

talking-to-junior-jim-talking-to-junior-.speaker: Junior Jim
talking-to-junior-jim-talking-to-junior-.text: Right, time to sort you out with a cargo hold. Let's head on over to the shipyard...

the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.text: If the player has not grabbed both the sawmill and hammer before talking to him:

steps.speaker: Junior Jim
steps.text: You'll want to grab yourself some tools from the crates over there, mate. After that, just use the gangplank to hop onto your raft. Once you're on board, you can get to work.

the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.text: If the player talks to Jim after grabbing the tools:

steps.speaker: Junior Jim
steps.text: Just use the gangplank over there to hop onto your raft. Once you're on board, you can use your tools to build a cargo hold. Don't worry about the materials, mate. I'm supplying those this time.

the-shipyard-taking-from-the-crate-of-ha.text: If the player does not already have a hammer:

steps.text: You take a hammer from the crate.

the-shipyard-taking-from-the-crate-of-ha.text: If the player already has a hammer:

steps.text: The crate is full of hammers, but you leave them as you already have one.

the-shipyard-taking-from-the-crate-of-sa.text: If the player does not already have a saw:

steps.text: You take a saw from the crate.

the-shipyard-taking-from-the-crate-of-sa.text: If the player already has a saw:

steps.text: The crate is full of saws, but you leave them as you already have one.

the-shipyard-modify-boat-schematics-befo.text: This is the schematics board. It's used to upgrade core parts of your boat, such as the hull. However, you have no reason to use it right now. You should focus on building your cargo hold instead.

the-shipyard-building-the-cargo-hold.text: Junior Jim helpfully provides the materials required to build the cargo hold.

the-shipyard-building-the-cargo-hold.speaker: Junior Jim
the-shipyard-building-the-cargo-hold.text: Very nice! Now, use the gangplank to hop back up here and we can get going.

the-shipyard-attempting-to-modify-the-ca.text: It doesn't seem like a good idea to modify anything right now.

the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.speaker: Junior Jim
the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.text: Smashing job on that cargo hold, mate. Let's get back to the Pandemonium, shall we?
The player is taken back to The Pandemonium

the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.speaker: Junior Jim
the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.text: Okay, looks like that's you all sorted, mate. I'd say you're now ready to set sail!

the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.speaker: Junior Jim
the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.text: Why don't you take your new raft out for a spin? You can head over to Port Sarim and collect that cargo for me. Oh, which reminds me, now that you're officially a captain, you'll need one of these.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: Junior Jim tries to give you a log book, but you don't have enough room to take it.

steps.speaker: Junior Jim
steps.text: Ah, seems you don't have room for it, mate. Why don't you come back later?

the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.text: Junior Jim gives you a log book.

the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.speaker: Junior Jim
the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.text: Your very own captain's log! You can use that to keep track of your adventures out at sea, including any work you might end up taking on.

the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.speaker: Junior Jim
the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.text: Right on, mate! In fact, I'll make a note of that in your log now.
Junior Jim updates your log with details on his request. You can consult the log at any point for a reminder on what he needs you to do.

the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.speaker: Junior Jim
the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.text: And that's you all ready to go, mate! Just hop on your new raft when ready. If you need help finding my cargo, just check in with the port master when you get to Port Sarim.

the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.speaker: Junior Jim
the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-again.text: Now, unless you fancy a cheeky dip, the gangplank down the docks will be your best bet for getting on board.
You can embark or disembark from your boat via docking points found around the world. To find a docking point, just look for the relevant icon on your map.

the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-after.speaker: Junior Jim
the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-after.text: You'll be needing one of these, mate.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: Junior Jim tries to give you a log book, but you don't have enough room to take it.

steps.speaker: Junior Jim
steps.text: Ah, seems you don't have room for it. Why don't you come back later?

the-shipyard-talking-to-junior-jim-after.text: Junior Jim gives you a log book.

the-shipyard-subsequent-dialogue-with-ju.speaker: Junior Jim
the-shipyard-subsequent-dialogue-with-ju.text: You should be all ready to go, mate! Just hop on your new raft when ready. If you need help finding my cargo, just check in with the port master when you get to Port Sarim.

the-shipyard-subsequent-dialogue-with-ju.speaker: Junior Jim
the-shipyard-subsequent-dialogue-with-ju.text: Now, unless you fancy a cheeky dip, the gangplank down the docks will be your best bet for getting on board.
You can embark or disembark from your boat via docking points found around the world. To find a docking point, just look for the relevant icon on your map.

at-port-sarim-talking-to-the-port-master.speaker: Port master
at-port-sarim-talking-to-the-port-master.text: Hi there. Do you need help with anything?

at-port-sarim-talking-to-the-port-master.player: I'm here to pick up some cargo for Junior Jim on the Pandemonium.

at-port-sarim-talking-to-the-port-master.text: If the player is holding the cargo:

steps.speaker: Port master
steps.text: Looks like you already have it. You'll need to take it back to the Pandemonium now.

at-port-sarim-talking-to-the-port-master.speaker: Port master
at-port-sarim-talking-to-the-port-master.text: Ah, you must be new to this. You can pick up and drop off cargo just over there at the ledger table.
Cargo can be picked up and dropped off at ledger tables found in various ports around the world. To find a ledger table, just look for the relevant icon on your map.

at-port-sarim-taking-cargo-from-the-ledg.text: You pick up a crate of ship parts.

at-port-sarim-depositing-cargo-at-the-le.text: You deposit the crate of ship parts.

at-the-pandemonium-disembarking-the-boat.prompt: Jim's cargo is still in your cargo hold.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.text: Alright, mate. How are you doing collecting my cargo?
If the player is not carrying the cargo:

steps.player: I'm still working on it.

steps.speaker: Junior Jim
steps.text: Well, you'd better hop back onto your raft then. Unless you fancy a cheeky dip, the gangplank down the docks will be your best bet for getting on board.
You can embark or disembark from your boat via docking points found around the world. To find a docking point, just look for the relevant icon on your map.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.text: If the player is carrying the cargo:

steps.player: I've got it right here.

steps.speaker: Junior Jim
steps.text: Very nice! Just hand that over to the port master and he'll sort it out. Come let me know once you're done.

steps.player: Okay, will do.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-port-m.speaker: Port master
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-port-m.text: Hi there. Can I help you with anything?

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-port-m.player: I'm here to drop off some cargo for Junior Jim.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-port-m.text: If the player is not carrying the cargo:

steps.speaker: Port master
steps.text: You don't seem to have any cargo on you.

steps.player: Oh, I must have left it in my cargo hold. I'll be right back.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-port-m.text: If the player is carrying the cargo:

steps.player: I'm here to drop off some cargo for Junior Jim.

steps.speaker: Port master
steps.text: Ah, very good. Just put it over by the ledger table and I'll get it sorted.
Cargo can be picked up and dropped off at ledger tables found in various ports around the world. To find a ledger table, just look for the relevant icon on your map.

at-the-pandemonium-dropping-off-the-carg.text: You deliver the crate of ship parts.

at-the-pandemonium-dropping-off-the-carg.speaker: Port master
at-the-pandemonium-dropping-off-the-carg.text: Thanks, sailor. I'll get that all sorted out. You should go let Jim know his cargo is here.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-port-m.speaker: Port master
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-the-port-m.text: Hi there. Can I help you with anything?

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.player: I collected your cargo and left it with the port master.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.text: Very nice! That's us all squared up then. You ought to pop back once you've got a bit more experience with that raft. By then I should have some new vessels for sale.
Shipwrights like Junior Jim can sell you new boats or help you upgrade your existing ones. To find a shipwright, just look for the relevant icon on your map.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.player: I might just do that. Any tips on the best ways to get that experience?

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.text: To be honest, mate, I'd say one of the best things would be to take on more work like what you just did for me. A lot of ports will have a notice board where folks advertise jobs they want sorting.
Port tasks can be accepted from notice boards found in various ports around the world. To find a notice board, just look for the relevant icon on your map.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.text: Well, now that you're officially a big cheese captain, you might want to start charting the sea for your own records. That log book I gave you has all sorts of cracking tips on how to do so.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.text: Oh, and while we're on about charting, I've also chucked some useful bits and bobs in your cargo hold.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.text: First up, I've left you a couple of repair kits in there. Perfect for if you go being a numpty and end up sailing straight into a proper big storm or a big group of sharks.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.text: The other thing in there is a spyglass. It's a proper handy charting tool that's great for getting a good look at things while out at sea.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.speaker: Junior Jim
at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.text: There's a chap called Charles who used to be pretty good at the whole charting thing who might be able to help you more. You can find him down in the cave on the island.

Your captain's log contains details on how to chart the sea. You can consult the log at any time for hints on what to chart. Charles in the cave on the Pandemonium can also help you out with sea charting.

at-the-pandemonium-talking-to-junior-jim.player: Great! Thanks, Jim. I'd better go check in with Steve now and see if Old Grog is back.

talking-to-steve.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
talking-to-steve.text: Aye! This Jolly Roger here is pretty keen to see some justice dealt! Old Grog, meet... er...

talking-to-steve.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
talking-to-steve.text: [player name]! And [player name], meet Old Grog.

talking-to-steve.speaker: Old Grog
talking-to-steve.text: Steve tells me you're keen to see Will and Anne dealt with. I'm open to sharing the bounty, but only if you have what it takes. I have no time for layabouts.

talking-to-steve.speaker: Old Grog
talking-to-steve.text: We'll see. I saw that raft you rocked up in. If that's all you bring to the table, then you have some work to do.

talking-to-steve.speaker: Old Grog
talking-to-steve.text: It will take me some time to track Will and Anne down, but make no mistake, I will find them. I expect you to be ready by the time that happens. Don't be a disappointment.

talking-to-steve.speaker: Old Grog
talking-to-steve.text: Good. Now, that's me done drinking. Time to get to work. I'll keep Steve updated on my progress, so make sure you're checking in with him. He'll let you know once I have something.

talking-to-steve.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
talking-to-steve.text: Yo ho ho, [player name]! Best you not waste time! Belay your helm and abaft your rigging! Get out there and make sure you're ready for Old Grog!

talking-to-steve.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
talking-to-steve.text: To help you on your way, I've got some pirate looty here for you! Sawmill coupons! Useful if you want a top vessel like mine.

talking-to-steve.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
talking-to-steve.text: Oh, and don't forget to pop back for a drink from time to time. My rum is to die for! Now, avast!

talking-to-steve-talking-to-steve-again-.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
talking-to-steve-talking-to-steve-again-.text: Yo ho ho, [player name]! Best you not waste time! Belay your helm and abaft your rigging! Get out there and make sure you're ready for Old Grog!

miscellaneous-before-sailing-release.speaker: Anne
miscellaneous-before-sailing-release.text: Ah, look what we have here, Will! This looks like someone who needs a good job!

miscellaneous-before-sailing-release.speaker: Will
miscellaneous-before-sailing-release.text: Goodness, Anne, I think you're right! This one's clearly never worked an honest day in their life, and it's about time someone changed that!

miscellaneous-before-sailing-release.speaker: Anne
miscellaneous-before-sailing-release.text: Alas! We are sadly not currently in a place where we can take on any more staff, but let us hope that changes soon!
The Sailing skill will release on the 19th November.

miscellaneous-on-a-deadman-mode-world.speaker: Anne
miscellaneous-on-a-deadman-mode-world.text: Ah, look what we have here, Will! This looks like someone who needs a good job!

miscellaneous-on-a-deadman-mode-world.speaker: Will
miscellaneous-on-a-deadman-mode-world.text: Goodness, Anne, I think you're right! This one's clearly never worked an honest day in their life, and it's about time someone changed that!

miscellaneous-on-a-deadman-mode-world.speaker: Anne
miscellaneous-on-a-deadman-mode-world.text: Alas! We are sadly not currently in a place where we can take on any more staff, but let us hope that changes soon!
Sailing quests are currently unavailable on this world.

KpSbKi.speaker: Will
KpSbKi.text: Oh dear! It doesn't quite look like you are! You'll need to make some room to carry some things before we head off!

XNeJmf.speaker: Will
XNeJmf.text: You need to take us to the wreck before we can use the salvaging hook, [player name]. It should be east of the Karamja Shipyard, so south of here.

IlKVPa.player: I seem to have lost it.

IlKVPa.speaker: Junior Jim
IlKVPa.text: You've got no boat. You've got no cup. You're fresh out of luck it would seem, mate. You'd best hope you lost it here on the Pandemonium. If so, someone might have handed it in to Steve.

IlKVPa.player: Then I guess I'd better go see if Steve has it.
